meta.title: Withdraw an event that is a draft project (option is labelled "Cancel Event") without a reason

steps.note: Open the prebuilt draft project without creating or searching for another event.
Confirm the draft exposes the Cancel Event option required by the case.
Attempt to withdraw the draft with no reason so Procol must enforce the reason requirement.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Assert the expected refusal message is shown.
Confirm the cancellation option remains available, showing that the draft was not withdrawn.
